# Manhuagui (看漫画) fixtures

`series.html` retains metadata and all 235 chapter links from [鬼灭之刃](https://www.manhuagui.com/comic/19430/), captured on 2026-10-25. The three category headings, paginated single-chapter markup, titles, and IDs retain their captured structure.

`reader.html` retains the eight-page `20卷附录` reader for chapter `494877`, including its packed 44-entry dictionary and reader-config URL. Signing values are synthetic. Browser mocks return controlled image bytes; derived vectors cover consent handling and smaller edge cases.
